title: Corporate Stances on Societal Issues in the US
abstract: arXiv:2611.19068v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When do firms take public positions on divisive societal issues and why? We assemble a comprehensive dataset on corporate stance-taking in the United States, using large language models to read 52,000 news articles and press releases about 836 companies that belonged to the S&P 500 at any point between 2008 and 2025. We identify 9,917 stances on nine partisan issues such as climate change, abortion, and racial discrimination. We show that stance-taking increased fourfold after 2008 and peaked in 2021. It is overwhelmingly liberal and concentrated among the largest firms. A quarter of stances give no explicit business justification. Stance-taking is only weakly related to lobbying and campaign contributions and, unlike them, does not follow the electoral cycle. translated_title: 美国企业在社会议题上的公开立场
translated_abstract: 企业何时会就争议性社会议题公开发表立场，原因何在？我们构建了一个关于美国企业立场表态的综合性数据集，利用大语言模型阅读了52,000篇关于836家公司（这些公司在2008年至2025年间曾属于标普500指数）的新闻报道和新闻稿，并从中识别出9,917个涉及气候变化、堕胎、种族歧视等九大党派性议题的立场表态。研究发现：2008年之后企业立场表态数量增长了四倍，并在2021年达到峰值；这些立场绝大多数为自由派立场，且集中在规模最大的企业中；四分之一的立场表态没有给出明确的商业理由；立场表态与游说活动和竞选捐款仅有微弱关联，且与后两者不同，它不跟随选举周期；相反，企业往往在媒体报道和公众对某一议题的关注度达到峰值时才发声。这些发现共同表明，立场表态可以被理解为对企业参与社会的一种贡献（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究利用大语言模型分析5.2万篇新闻报道，构建了美国标普500企业就九大党派性议题立场表态的综合数据集，发现此类表态自2008年后增长四倍、以自由派为主、集中于大企业，且主要跟随媒体关注度而非选举周期或商业利益驱动。
en_tdlr: This study uses large language models to analyze 52,000 news articles, building a comprehensive dataset of US corporate stances on nine partisan issues, and finds that stance-taking quadrupled after 2008, is predominantly liberal and concentrated among the largest firms, and tracks peaks in media attention and public interest rather than electoral cycles or lobbying.
